# pr-1587: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']

Formatted 15 files (0 changed) in 0.21 seconds.
## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking

# pr-1587: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']

## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue. Rework round 2 (merge + guards):
  `validateAgentSection`'s per-key switch became the `_agentKeyValidators`
  table (the two gh-1572 keys pushed the switch form to complexity 13 —

# pr-1587: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']

## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue. Rework round 2 (merge + guards):
  `validateAgentSection`'s per-key switch became the `_agentKeyValidators`
  table (the two gh-1572 keys pushed the switch form to complexity 13 —

# pr-1587: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census

      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800

      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)

## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue. Rework round 2 (merge + guards):
  `validateAgentSection`'s per-key switch became the `_agentKeyValidators`

# pr-1587: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys

Formatted 15 files (0 changed) in 0.21 seconds.
## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue. Rework round 2 (merge + guards):
  `validateAgentSection`'s per-key switch became the `_agentKeyValidators`
  table (the two gh-1572 keys pushed the switch form to complexity 13 —
  over the repo's CRAP ratchet; the table keeps the mirror complete at

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)

## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue. Rework round 2 (merge + guards):
  `validateAgentSection`'s per-key switch became the `_agentKeyValidators`

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:

Formatted 15 files (0 changed) in 0.21 seconds.
## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']

## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue. Rework round 2 (merge + guards):
  `validateAgentSection`'s per-key switch became the `_agentKeyValidators`

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800

      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)

Formatted 15 files (0 changed) in 0.21 seconds.
## Unreleased

- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue. Rework round 2 (merge + guards):
  `validateAgentSection`'s per-key switch became the `_agentKeyValidators`
  table (the two gh-1572 keys pushed the switch form to complexity 13 —
  over the repo's CRAP ratchet; the table keeps the mirror complete at
